what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/synthesis/spec.md, tasks/synthesis/dev.json and the checker code in lab/core.py

Designed 21 tasks, each with a record document plus claim documents or a claim in the question; answers are a document letter, a SUPPORTED/REFUTED label, a strict JSON verdict+letter (2 tasks) or a document id / label in tool mode (2 tasks)

Built the file with a Python generator script that computes every expected answer from the task's own figures and asserts that exactly one claim matches the record (no ties) and that prompts stay under 1500 characters
Ran lab/validate_tasks.py until every reference passed and every negative failed
answer_verification: Each expected answer is computed in Python inside the generator (sums, counts, carry-forward simulation, mean/median, due dates, unit conversion, per-item differences, running balance) with assert statements on the result and on uniqueness of the matching claim; per-task computation notes are in per_task_verification.
